narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The e621 Reading Room"**

A calm, dark room built from e621's own Hexagon navies, where the art is the only bright thing. Each post sits in a navy e621 panel, like e621's post boxes: the artist line on top, the picture inset by 8, then favourite, score and tags underneath. Structure is iOS (large titles, round 44 toolbar buttons, a floating glass capsule tab bar, grouped settings, bottom sheets). The playful touch is small and physical: pressable things have a solid darker edge that sinks when tapped, titles and numbers speak in a rounded face, and a short celebration marks "You're caught up".

Density is phone-first and one-handed: a 16 edge, a closed size system (6 spacing steps, 4 control heights, 4 avatar sizes, 3 icon sizes, 4 radii), and the main action in thumb reach at the bottom right. Dark by default for dark rooms; there is no light theme.

The art is never tinted, framed by gradients or covered. The only things that may sit on top of a picture are the video play glyph and the mute button; the player adds its own controls, which auto-hide.
keyCharacteristics: e621 navies as the neutral; one gold, used sparingly.
Navy panels around art, never overlays on it.
Rounded face for voice, system face for reading.
A 2 to 3 px same-hue lip on pressables, sinking in 100 ms.
Colour carries meaning: gold = act / new / here, green = score, pink = favourite, e621 tag category colours on tags.
Kaleidoscope avatars (e621 has no artist pictures) and a kaleidoscope app mark.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold fills one thing per screen: its main action. Everywhere else gold is a label, a dot, a ring or a glyph that says "new" or "you are here". A second gold fill on a screen is a bug.

rules.name: The Art Is the Light Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the interface is brighter or more saturated than the art. Navy is the neutral; meaning colours appear only as small icons, numbers and tag text.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Rounded for what the app says (names, numbers, actions); system for what you read. Nothing in between, and no sizes outside the table.

rules.name: The Lip Is a Promise Rule
rules.body: A lip means "press me". It goes on gold and tonal buttons, Follow, the fav pill and both Play buttons. Never on panels, tags, chips, toolbar circles, or anything that sits over art.

dos: **Do** keep every value on the closed size system: spacing 4/8/12/16/24/32, controls 44/32/52/56/62, avatars 24/36/44/80, icons 24/20/16, radii 8/12/16/24/capsule.
**Do** fill gold once per screen, for the main action; use gold otherwise only for "New", the current tab, a selected chip's ring and the Follow plus.
**Do** put posts in navy panels with the artist line on top, the picture inset 8, and stats and tags below.
**Do** give compact controls a 44 hit area and every number tabular figures.
**Do** lift any new small-text colour to 4.5:1 on the surface it sits on, keeping its e621 hue.
donts: **Don't** put anything on top of the art except the video play glyph and mute (and the player's own auto-hiding controls). No Instagram-style hearts, names or gradients over pictures.
**Don't** tint or frame art with colour washes; navy panels may surround it, never cover it.
**Don't** put a lip on panels, tags, chips, toolbar circles or anything over art, and never use blurred drop shadows on controls.
**Don't** use a second accent colour, or meaning colours as fills.
**Don't** use muted text on Raised Highlight (3.9:1).
**Don't** borrow Duolingo's owl, green, streaks, gems or guilt nudges, or AllTrails' green, logo or buttons on photos.
